Ecwid is an e-commerce platform acquired by Lightspeed Commerce in 2021. The Lightspeed Service Agreement (governing Ecwid as of November 2024) explicitly disclaims all service level warranties and cannot guarantee continuous availability. No uptime SLA, credit remedy, or refund structure exists in the public terms.
